name: Centaur Bracers
summary: West of the Crossroads, Regthar Deathgate seeks proof against the Kolkar. Their raids threaten Horde control of the central Barrens.

sections.title: Securing the Plains
sections.body: The young Horde is still securing its lands across Kalimdor. The Barrens stretch between Durotar and Mulgore, where Kolkar centaurs contest the watering holes and open plains. Their attacks fall on supply trains and scouting parties. From his bunker west of the Crossroads, the orc warrior Regthar Deathgate directs the defense.

sections.title: A Gruesome Accounting
sections.body: Regthar asks for proof that Kolkar warriors have fallen. Soldiers who enter Kolkar territory return with bracers taken from slain centaurs. These trophies support claims for Horde bounties, and Regthar hopes they will frighten the surviving raiders.

faq.answer: Regthar Deathgate is an orc commander in a fortified bunker west of the Crossroads. He leads the Horde effort to suppress centaur raiders across the Barrens.

faq.q: Why does the Horde want centaur bracers?
faq.answer: Centaur bracers prove enemy warriors fell in the field. Regthar uses them to ensure bounties go only to those who inflict actual casualties on the hostile Kolkar tribes.

faq.q: Why are the Kolkar attacking the Horde?
faq.answer: The Kolkar are a brutal centaur clan native to central Kalimdor, and they seek to expand. They claim the Barrens as hunting grounds and fight the new settlements, camps, and alliances formed by orcs and tauren.

faq.q: Where are the Kolkar centaurs located in the Barrens?
faq.answer: Kolkar raiding camps lie around oases and rugged ridges across the central and southern Barrens. The centaurs often dispute access to water and routes through the region.

faq.q: Does collecting these bracers stop the Kolkar attacks?
faq.answer: No. Regthar hopes the losses will frighten the surviving raiders, but he doubts the Kolkar will willingly stop their attacks.

faq.q: What is the strategic value of the Crossroads?
faq.answer: The Crossroads links Durotar, the tauren plains of Mulgore, and northern routes into Ashenvale. Defeating nearby centaur war parties helps keep Horde supply lines intact.

angles.text: Clearing the Kolkar protects supply links between Orgrimmar and Thunder Bluff.
As a tauren, you know the centaur have devastated tauren tribes and committed genocide against them for centuries. Thinning their numbers in the Barrens is personal retribution.
As an orc, you help secure Durotar's borders against nomadic raiders and establish a permanent, stable homeland.
